競合(SpaceXは打上げ供給元でもある)
rows.en: Competitors (SpaceX is also a launch provider)

relations.text: AST SpaceMobileは、AT&T、Verizon、STC、Vodafoneと最終的な商業契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: AST SpaceMobile has definitive commercial agreements with AT&T, Verizon, STC and Vodafone

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: To date, we have entered into definitive commercial agreements with AT&T, Verizon, STC and Vodafone and approximately 50 preliminary agreements and understandings with other MNOs.

relations.text: 2024年6月5日付の修正株主間契約に、AT&Tが当事者として含まれる
relations.text_en: AT&T is a party to the Amended Stockholders' Agreement dated June 5, 2024

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: • “Amended Stockholders’ Agreement” refers to that Certain Stockholders’ Agreement, dated as of June 5, 2024, by and among the Company, the AST Equityholders, and AT&T.

relations.text: 2025年10月8日、2026年から米国本土とハワイのVerizon顧客向けに直接通信サービスを提供する最終的な商業契約を発表した
relations.text_en: On October 8, 2025, AST announced a definitive commercial agreement with Verizon to provide direct-to-cellular service to Verizon customers in the continental US and Hawaii starting in 2026

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: On October 8, 2025, we announced the signing of a definitive commercial agreement with Verizon to provide direct-to-cellular AST SpaceMobile service when needed for Verizon customers within the continental United States (excluding Alaska) and Hawaii starting in 2026.

relations.text: 2024年5月23日、劣後転換社債を総額3,500万ドルでVerizonに発行した
relations.text_en: On May 23, 2024, AST issued $35.0 million of subordinated convertible notes to Verizon

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: Pursuant to the Convertible Security Investment Agreement which we entered into with certain investors, we issued subordinated convertible notes (“2034 Convertible Notes”) for an aggregate principal amount of $110.0 million on January 16, 2024 to AT&T, Google, and Vodafone, and for an aggregate principal amount of $35.0 million on May 23, 2024 to Verizon.

relations.text: 2025年12月18日、Vodafoneと共同保有する欧州の衛星サービス会社(SatCo)が、欧州・英国などのMNOへSpaceMobileサービスを独占的に販売する再販契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On December 18, 2025, AST entered into a reseller agreement with its jointly-owned European satellite service business with Vodafone (SatCo) to exclusively distribute SpaceMobile Service to MNOs in Europe, the UK and certain other markets

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: On December 18, 2025, we entered into a reseller agreement with our jointly-owned European satellite service business with Vodafone (“SatCo”) to exclusively distribute SpaceMobile Service to MNOs in Europe, UK and certain other markets.

relations.text: 2024年1月16日、劣後転換社債(2034年満期)をAT&T、Google、Vodafoneに合計1億1,000万ドル発行した
relations.text_en: On January 16, 2024, AST issued $110.0 million of subordinated convertible notes (2034 Convertible Notes) to AT&T, Google and Vodafone

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: Pursuant to the Convertible Security Investment Agreement which we entered into with certain investors, we issued subordinated convertible notes (“2034 Convertible Notes”) for an aggregate principal amount of $110.0 million on January 16, 2024 to AT&T, Google, and Vodafone, and for an aggregate principal amount of $35.0 million on May 23, 2024 to Verizon.

relations.text: 欧州各国でVodafoneやDeutsche Telekomなどとネットワーク統合・試験が進行中である
relations.text_en: Network integration and testing activities are underway across European countries with Vodafone, Orange, Telefonica and Deutsche Telekom, among others

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: o Network integration and testing activities now underway across European countries with Vodafone, Orange, Telefónica, Vodafone Ukraine, and Deutsche Telekom as well as in other key markets including Canada, Japan, and Saudi Arabia, subject to final regulatory approvals
source.note: 規制当局の最終承認が前提の計画段階です。
source.note_en: Planned, subject to final regulatory approvals.

relations.text: Orange、Telefonicaなどと世界で商業提携を拡大した
relations.text_en: AST expanded commercial partnerships globally with Orange, Telefonica and others

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: o Expanded commercial partnerships globally with Orange, Telefonica, CK Hutchison, Taiwan Mobile, Sunrise, and progressed initiatives with Vodafone

relations.text: 2024年1月16日、劣後転換社債をAT&T、Google、Vodafoneに合計1億1,000万ドル発行した
relations.text_en: On January 16, 2024, AST issued $110.0 million of subordinated convertible notes to AT&T, Google and Vodafone

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: Pursuant to the Convertible Security Investment Agreement which we entered into with certain investors, we issued subordinated convertible notes (“2034 Convertible Notes”) for an aggregate principal amount of $110.0 million on January 16, 2024 to AT&T, Google, and Vodafone, and for an aggregate principal amount of $35.0 million on May 23, 2024 to Verizon.
source.note: 出資の一部としての記載です。

relations.text: 2020年2月4日付の修正再録Series B優先株購入契約の当事者に、Rakuten Mobile Singaporeが含まれる
relations.text_en: Rakuten Mobile Singapore is a party to the Amended and Restated Series B Preferred Shares Purchase Agreement dated February 4, 2020

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: Amended and Restated Series B Preferred Shares Purchase Agreement, dated as of February 4, 2020, by and among AST & Science, LLC, Vodafone Ventures Limited, ATC TRS II LLC and Rakuten Mobile Singapore PTE.
source.note: 子会社レベルで、時期は古いです。

relations.text: 年次報告が、SpaceXのStarlinkを直接通信分野の競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report names SpaceX's Starlink as a competitor in the direct-to-device segment

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: We face competition from existing and new companies including SpaceX’s Starlink, which is developing satellite communications technology using LEO constellations to provide competitive services in the direct-to-device segment of the mobile satellite services industry.

relations.text: BlueBird衛星の打上げ契約先の1社としてSpaceXが挙げられている
relations.text_en: SpaceX is named among the launch providers under agreement for BlueBird satellites

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Network deployment targeting approximately 45 BlueBird satellites in orbit during 2026, supported by our manufacturing cadence and agreements with multiple launch providers, including Blue Origin, SpaceX, and others

companies.name: イリジウム・コミュニケーションズ

relations.text: 年次報告が、競合としてIridium Communicationsを挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report names Iridium Communications as a competitor

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: In addition, we face competition from existing service providers such as Inmarsat Global Limited (“Inmarsat”), Globalstar, Thuraya Telecommunications Co., Iridium Communications and Skylo that offer a range of mobile and fixed communications options.

relations.text: 年次報告が、競合としてGlobalstarを挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report names Globalstar as a competitor

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-K
source.quote: In addition, we face competition from existing service providers such as Inmarsat Global Limited (“Inmarsat”), Globalstar, Thuraya Telecommunications Co., Iridium Communications and Skylo that offer a range of mobile and fixed communications options.
